notes:
Account summary: ByteAnchor builds an IDE-focused copilots suite integrated into VS Code and JetBrains. They care about deterministic code completion and reproducibility across releases — customers (internal and enterprise) require that a given commit + prompt produce the same completion when pinned to a model/version/quantization profile.

Recent conversations: AE (Maya) + SE (Ravi) demoed Redwood Optimize suggestions and model pinning API on 2026-02-18 (ff-2026-02-18-94ab). They liked rollout primitives: canaries + eval gates. CTO quote: "We need to be able to blame model changes — not just the prompt."

Technical requirements:
- Primary workload: low-latency single-token streaming for inline completions in IDE (median latency target <150ms, p95 <300ms).
- Throughput: thousands of concurrent low-QPS sessions (many sticky sessions from editor long-lived sockets).
- Reproducibility: pin model artifact (model-id + tokenizer version + quantization profile + model-weights-hash) per release; ability to run regression evals on a fixed prompt set before rollout.
- Rollouts: need canary traffic split by user cohort, automatic rollback on eval gate failures, and A/B testing for new model variants.
- Fallbacks: must fallback to a smaller quantized variant on node capacity pressure, but only if the eval gate passes threshold for code correctness ratings.

Security/compliance: SOC2 required, SAML SSO for enterprise customers, audit logs for every inference (metadata-only acceptable), optional KMS integration for key management. They will demand data residency for some enterprise customers (EU).

POC plan: medium-fidelity integration into their staging VS Code extension. 2-week canary where 5% of npm/pypi orgs get new model variant; run automated eval harness (unit-style code prompts + canonical answers) daily. Redwood to provide the eval gate dashboard and preconfigured prompt set runner.

Risks & unknowns:
- Tokenization differences across model families cause deterministic mismatch; need a way to pin tokenizer + pre-tokenize test prompts.
- Cost concerns: streaming per-token cost may spike; they'd like batching suggestions from Redwood Optimize.
- Legal: retention window and deletion of logs must be contractually guaranteed for EU accounts.

Next steps (short):
- Deliver model-pinning API spec and sample code for the extension (by 2026-03-16).
- Schedule SAML cert exchange and staging test (target 2026-03-18).
- Kick off the canary with seeded prompt set and baseline metrics collection (target start 2026-03-22).

Stubs/links: pricing deck (drive link above), security FAQ (drive link), internal ticket INF-4821 for canary infra requests.
